author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
BerrylandMC is a sequel/revisit to CherrylandMC, but features the Blueberries' point of view. This is how they see the mystical Cherryland in their eyes, and now the Cherries have been struct with the same thing. They are trapped into the map and cannot reverse it. Their old home, Cherryland, is forever peeked out of their vision. From what was once happy has slid into a state of the Cherries' demise. The only way to escape the cycle is to finish off the Berries and get back what once was.

Features:
- Automatic Defense System (Break a cobblestone block in the monument area, the monument will be chewed up by silverfish and a pit will be dug.)

- TNT Parkour (To discourage griefers a tiny bit, you now have to enter a portal and complete a parkour system to gain TNT blocks as well as other supplies.)

- Renewables (Breaking gold blocks will give you a gold block, but once broken they will reappear. This is to stop supply hogging and make an infinite system for armor/tools/whatever).

- Iron Block Boosts (Breaking iron blocks will reward you with jump boost and haste for 60 seconds. You can use it to scout across the map and become a tank, however when breaking it it will not reappear. There are only 4 around.) You also receive a golden apple.

Authors:
- Trans4rm2me (Main builder)
- ParaSpider (Main builder)
- Kreshellio (Minor tweaks)

Download
Images
YAML (WIP by Para)

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
The parkour is really easy so it won't be too much of a task getting TNT. As for the quick question, if you get the TNT you get 2 stacks. If you want more, you can hop in and redo the parkour to get another 2 stacks. Rinse and repeat.

I do not know if cuboid spawns are going to be added or not, but I'll certainly bring it up as it sounds interesting and would be less cluttering, as well as possibly making it work for cylinders and such.

You can already do this (scroll down to quickfix). I believe that you could do that to a certain block then add an allowance of building.

Also, YAML is done.
